def _pairwise_distances(pts):
    """Compute pairwise distances between all points."""
    d = cdist(pts, pts)
    mask = ~np.eye(N, dtype=bool)
    return d[mask]

def _true_score(pts):
    """Calculate the actual score: (max/min)^2."""

    mx = d.max()
    if mn < 1e-9:
        return np.inf

def _objective(x):
